self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: After Normal/Plunging hits: full self state (2 stacks) grants DEF +16% and All DMG +20% at R1. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

Halcyon Years Unending, 2nd clause: once Ode to Flowers reaches 2 stacks (or the 2nd stack refreshes), all nearby party members gain All Elemental DMG Bonus equal to 8% for every 1,000 DEF the equipping character has, up to +25.6%, for 15s. R1 values; R5 is 16% per 1,000 DEF up to +51.2%. Both tiers cap from 3,200 DEF. Self scope, so this only applies when the wielder is the scored character: the rate is an eval-time conversion off the build's own post-buff DEF -- including this weapon's own Ode to Flowers DEF% -- rather than the flat cap every entrant used to receive. Refinement-aware through refinementStates.

others_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Halcyon Years Unending, 2nd clause: once Ode to Flowers reaches 2 stacks (or the 2nd stack refreshes), all nearby party members gain All Elemental DMG Bonus equal to 8% for every 1,000 DEF the equipping character has, up to +25.6%, for 15s. R1 values; R5 is 16% per 1,000 DEF up to +51.2%. Both tiers cap from 3,200 DEF. Others scope, so this only applies when a teammate holds the weapon: their DEF is not on the scored build, so the admin types it. NOTE the typed box carries the R1 rate and cap; a board that overrides this weapon to a higher refinement should pick the 'full' preset instead, which is refinement-tiered.
